procedure: Obtain human authorization binding the reviewed local commit and this single scenario.
Confirm dedicated origin, build and hashes; verify the existing demo identity internally, without persisting account identifiers.
Require recent demo authorization evidence within 15 minutes. If needed, the operator must prepare and close the dedicated terminal manually; the executor never closes processes.
Block if any dedicated or unidentified terminal is running, compiled services are present, or a retained reservation exists. Do not remove a lock automatically.
Use NativeLocalBackend only with explicit authorization and LocalTesterExecutor with simulate=false and authorized=true, state_root=C:/estrategia/runs.
Create a fresh UUID directory and credential-free INI; acquire the installation OS guard and durable reservation; refuse a preexisting report.
Consume one attempt before launch. Launch only the dedicated terminal using /config with the new INI. No retries or parameter changes.
Collect new journal byte ranges, report metrics and hashes. Require dedicated identity, requested scenario, local-only settings, effective Tester completion and zero trades/deals.
Write result, manifest and external receipt before releasing a successful reservation. Verify them with verify_run_artifacts.
On timeout, build change, missing evidence or unknown process state, preserve the lock and classify inconclusive. Do not kill processes or rerun. Recovery requires a separate explicit review.
Stop and present the evidence for human assessment.
approval_criteria: Not simulated; exactly one attempted launch and one completed native test.
Dedicated executable, data folder, build 6361 and expected source/EX5 hashes verified before and after.
Report and journal bound to the fresh execution ID and collected ranges; no reuse of previous results.
EURUSD/M5, 2023-11-01 through 2023-11-02 exclusive, M1 OHLC proven in independent journal/report evidence.
Report records zero trades and zero deals; journal proves Test passed and automatic testing finished.
All artifact hashes and the independent receipt verify.
No MCP use, no historical installation access, no credential persistence, no strategy modification.
